title: Oozy Juicy Saudi Arabian Lamb Tagine
description: A romantic Saudi Arabian dish featuring tender lamb in a rich umami glaze, perfect for a special occasion. This recipe serves 6 people and is cooked to perfection in a traditional cazuela vessel.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in the bottom of a large cazuela over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion to the cazuela and cook until it is softened and lightly browned.
Add the minced garlic and grated ginger to the cazuela and cook for 1 minute.
Add the lamb pieces to the cazuela and cook until they are browned on all sides.
Add the cumin, coriander, and cayenne pepper to the cazuela and stir to combine.
Add the prunes, honey, and boiling water to the cazuela and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer the tagine, covered, for 2.5 hours.
Remove the lid from the cazuela and simmer the tagine for an additional 30 minutes.
Season the tagine with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve the tagine hot, garnished with fresh parsley and toasted almonds.
